title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-witness provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, and publication evidence.

The P22 cluster now constructs the actual finite localized first Smith pair, freely restores the source's arbitrary and countable common identity tail, proves exact cancellation back to the finite quotient, and formalizes the scalar module-slash formulas following equation (24) as Mathlib colon ideals. One-step quotients isolate the corresponding principal Smith-coefficient ideal unconditionally. Quotienting by the whole ground module is proved as the infimum of the remaining principal ideals and is simplified to one displayed ideal only under an explicit greatest-remaining-divisor hypothesis. The scalar module contains 15 generic NEW_PACKAGING declarations and 20 source-instantiated FORMALIZED_GAP declarations.

The free finitely supported tail is not yet identified with an independently constructed historical unbounded zeta module. Canonical divisibility ordering, normalization, choice independence, determinant-norm/resultant identification, infinite determinants or products, later elimination stages, compatible zeros, and multiplicity conclusions remain open. Lean verification certifies only formal statements and explicit assumptions; it does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
